title: The Wandering Herbalist
description: A stooped figure in a patchwork cloak picks herbs along the trail, humming tunelessly. A massive wicker basket on their back overflows with dried plants, mushrooms, and glass vials. They notice you and smile with far too many teeth. 'Travelers! Care to trade?'

choices.label: Buy their wares
choices.description: Pay 12 gold for whatever they're selling.

outcomes.text: The herbalist hands you a bundle of fresh herbs and a mushroom that pulses faintly. 'Good for what ails you!'
They rummage through their basket and produce a glowing salve. 'Rub this on wounds — works wonders!' Your heroes feel refreshed.
The herbalist hands you unlabeled vials with a wink. 'Trust me.' The contents taste foul but seem... invigorating?
'Ah, careful through the next stretch — saw beast tracks. Big ones.' They hand you a sprig of wolfsbane. 'For luck.'
The herbalist draws a crude map in the dirt showing a shortcut. 'Found a hidden stash last week — might still be there.'
They ramble incoherently about 'the green song' and 'root-whispers' for ten minutes. You learn nothing useful.

choices.label: Demand their supplies
choices.description: That basket looks full of valuable ingredients.

outcomes.text: The herbalist drops the basket and flees. Their loss is your gain — herbs, mushrooms, and a few coins.
The herbalist's smile vanishes. They hurl a vial that shatters at your feet — choking gas! You grab what you can through streaming eyes.
They cackle and throw powder in your face. When your vision clears, they're gone — and so is some of your gold.
